command: LOCK="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/riccon-maven.lock"; while ! mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 5; done; trap 'rmdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT; LOGD="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ev-0195-default.log"; ./mvnw -q -T1C -pl apps/worker -am test -Dtest=OpenSearchPropertiesBindingTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false > "$LOGD" 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -5 "$LOGD"; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then exit $rc; fi; LOGA="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ev-0195-adr-v2.log"; env RICCON_OPENSEARCH_INDEX_VERSION=v2 ./mvnw -q -T1C -pl apps/worker -am test -Dtest=OpenSearchPropertiesBindingTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false > "$LOGA" 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -5 "$LOGA"; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then exit $rc; fi; LOGW="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ev-0195-worker-v2.log"; env RICCON_WORKER_OPENSEARCH_INDEX_VERSION=v2 RICCON_WORKER_OPENSEARCH_INDEX_PREFIX=worker-host ./mvnw -q -T1C -pl apps/worker -am test -Dtest=OpenSearchPropertiesBindingTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false > "$LOGW" 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -5 "$LOGW"; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then exit $rc; fi; LOGS="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ev-0195-spotless.log"; ./mvnw -q -pl apps/worker spotless:check > "$LOGS" 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -5 "$LOGS"; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then exit $rc; fi; grep -o 'tests="[0-9]*" errors="[0-9]*" skipped="[0-9]*" failures="[0-9]*"' apps/worker/target/surefire-reports/TEST-com.riccon.worker.index.service.OpenSearchPropertiesBindingTest.xml | head -1; exit 0
